### `reaction add`

React to a message with one or more unicode or custom emoji.

`sendReaction` carries the whole desired state, so tlgr reads the reactions this account already has and resends them alongside the new one; `--replace` sends exactly what was asked for instead. Reacting twice is `already: true`, not an error.

```
tlgr reaction add <CHAT> <MSG_ID> [EMOJI]... [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · idempotent (reports `already`) · returns `ReactionResult`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Chat. |
| `MSG_ID` | msg-id | yes | Message id or link. |
| `EMOJI` | text | one or more | Reactions; omit to clear them all. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--big` | flag |  | Play the big animation. |
| `--custom` | int |  | Custom (Premium) emoji id; repeatable. |
| `--recent` | flag |  | Remember it as recently used. |
| `--replace` | flag |  | Send exactly this set instead of adding to mine. |
| `--send-as` | chat |  | Paid reactions only. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr msg react`, `tlgr react add`, `tlgr message react`

```console
$ tlgr reaction add @alice 12345 👍 --json
```

Full: `emoji.interaction`, `messages-core.reaction-add-remove`, `messages-core.saved-tags-add`, `reaction.add-to-recent`, `reaction.big`, `reaction.send-custom-emoji`, `reaction.send-emoji`, `reaction.send-multiple`, `reaction.service-messages`

### `reaction catalog`

The reaction catalogue: standard, featured, or my recently used.

Three endpoints, one row shape; `source` says which list a row came from. `--forget` clears the recently-used list first.

```
tlgr reaction catalog [OPTIONS]
```

**paginated (`LOCAL` cursor) · returns `Page[AvailableReaction]`**

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--forget` | flag |  | Clear the recently-used list. |
| `--recent` | flag |  | My recently used reactions. |
| `--refresh` | flag |  | Ignore the cached hash. |
| `--top` | flag |  | Featured / top reactions. |

Pagination is transport-level: `--limit/-n`, `--cursor TOKEN`, `--all` (walked inside the daemon, paced by the account's own rate limiter).

Also invocable as: `tlgr react catalog`

```console
$ tlgr reaction catalog --json
```

### `reaction chat get`

Which reactions a chat (or one message) allows.

`chatFull`/`channelFull.available_reactions` is the source of truth. With `--msg-id` an `all` policy is expanded against the live catalogue, which is the set that would actually be accepted.

```
tlgr reaction chat get <CHAT> [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `ChatReactions`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Chat. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--msg-id` | msg-id |  | Narrow to one message. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr reaction available`

```console
$ tlgr reaction chat get @news --json
```

### `reaction chat set`

Restrict which reactions a chat allows, cap them, enable Star reactions.

Needs the `change_info` admin right. Because the wire field is mandatory, tlgr reads the current policy first and resends it unchanged when only the cap or the Star switch was asked for.

```
tlgr reaction chat set <CHAT> [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · returns `ChatReactions`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Chat. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--allow-custom` | flag |  | Allow custom-emoji reactions. |
| `--every` | flag |  | Allow every reaction. |
| `--max-unique` | int |  | Cap unique reactions per message. |
| `--none` | flag |  | Disable reactions. |
| `--paid` | on|off |  | Star (paid) reactions on a channel. |
| `--some` | text |  | Allow exactly this set. |

```console
$ tlgr reaction chat set @news --some 👍,❤ --json
```

### `reaction pay`

Send a Star (paid) reaction to a channel post.

Spends real Stars. `--stars` is mandatory, there is no default amount, and a failed payment is never retried automatically. `--senders` lists the identities you could pay as without paying.

```
tlgr reaction pay <CHAT> <MSG_ID> [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · destructive (needs `--yes` off a TTY) · returns `PaidReactionResult`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Channel. |
| `MSG_ID` | msg-id | yes | Post id. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--anonymous` | flag |  | Hide my name on the leaderboard. |
| `--send-as` | chat |  | Pay as my channel. |
| `--senders` | flag |  | List the peers I may pay as, instead of paying. |
| `--stars` | int |  | How many Stars to send. |

```console
$ tlgr reaction pay @news 12345 --stars 50 --json
```

<details><summary>Catalog coverage (4 full, 0 partial)</summary>

Full: `messages-core.reaction-paid-star`, `reaction.live-story-paid`, `reaction.paid-send`, `reaction.paid-send-as`

### `reaction remove`

Remove one of my reactions, or all of them.

Naming no reaction removes all of mine. A reaction that was not there is `already: true`, so a retry is safe.

```
tlgr reaction remove <CHAT> <MSG_ID> [EMOJI] [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · idempotent (reports `already`) · returns `ReactionResult`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Chat. |
| `MSG_ID` | msg-id | yes | Message id or link. |
| `EMOJI` | text | no | Which one; omit for all of mine. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--custom` | int |  | Remove this custom-emoji reaction. |
| `--every` | flag |  | Remove every reaction of mine. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr message unreact`, `tlgr react remove`

```console
$ tlgr reaction remove @alice 12345 👍 --json
```

### `reaction report`

Report a reaction, optionally blocking the member who left it.

Only valid on your own posts. Reporting cannot be undone from a client.


### `reaction unread list`

`--read-all` drives `messages.readReactions` until its offset comes back zero; calling it once clears only the first page of the badge.
